• The word **"QUIESCENT"** refers to a state of inactivity or dormancy, where something is at rest or not active. (निष्क्रिय, शांत)

• **Example:** The volcano has been quiescent for decades, showing no signs of erupting.

• **"Dormant"** also means inactive or in a state of rest, often temporarily so. (निष्क्रिय)

• **Example:** The seeds remain dormant until the spring rains awaken them.
